name: L. Q. C. Lamar
bio: The Secretary of the Interior in President Cleveland's cabinet was criticized by the Cow Boy in July 1885 for ordering the Texas cattle trails opened against the wishes of the states, territories and stock associations along them. In September 1886 the paper reported his final ruling that the contested Hawkes claim in Deadwood was mineral land, costing business owners their improvements.
